fact: The director of the General Administration of Civil Registry announced services back at full capacity in all secure states after central databases and systems were restored, with civil registry centres resuming after a stoppage of more than two years.
title: مدير الإدارة العامة للسجل المدني يؤكد عودة خدمات السجل بكامل طاقتها في كافة الولايات الآمنة
